name: week
title: Weekly failure review
subtitle: Fictional demo when seeded. Read-only snapshot.

sections.title: Engineering round
sections.sql: select code,analysis_code,mode,severity,action_priority,reviewed,open_actions,current_controls from failure_register order by code

sections.title: Outstanding actions
sections.sql: select code,failure,owner,due,status,overdue from action_register where status<>'verified' order by due,code

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from review_findings order by rule,code

sections.title: Controls
sections.sql: select c.code,f.code failure,c.characteristic,c.method,c.frequency,c.reaction,c.failure_revision,f.revision current_revision from controls c join failures f on f.id=c.failure_id order by c.code
